verdict.rationale: Mailgun has native background automation primitives: inbound routing rules that forward or store mail, webhooks that push real-time events so apps can automate responses without polling, and automatic handling of bounces, unsubscribes and complaints. Community users confirm the inbound rules run unattended for years. Broader multi-step workflows depend on external tools such as n8n, GitHub Actions or Supabase Edge Functions, and the MCP server is conversational rather than autonomous. Missing for 10: a native workflow or automation builder with scheduling, agent-driven autonomous automations (the MCP server is interactive only), and hands-on evidence of the n8n/GitHub/Supabase integrations running unattended.
